title: Nexus ToolsApi
description: Host tool invocation request: the typed entry point of the capability spine, shared by HTTP, the internal agent-host route and schedule dispatch. `parameters` stays an unrestricted JSON value because that IS the capability contract — a capability declares a JSON Schema and receives arguments matching it, so the capability schema (never a Rust type per tool) is the authority for the payload.

parameters.description: Tool arguments; any JSON value, validated against the capability's declared schema.

session_id.description: Session this call belongs to, when the caller has one.

request_id.description: Caller-supplied request id, for audit correlation.

caller_kind.description: Who is calling, when it is not the ordinary HTTP path.
